@mermaid-js/tiny 11.17.2 retained license and upstream notice

Performance variant: Lantern vendors the official @mermaid-js/tiny 11.17.2 browser build from the Mermaid repository instead of the 3.57 MB full standalone build. The upstream Tiny README describes it as the web-optimized Mermaid subset and explicitly removes Mindmap, Architecture, KaTeX rendering, and Mermaid's internal lazy-loading. Lantern requires the seven verified types (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, pie) and supplies its own one-request page-level lazy load.
Vendored file source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mermaid-js/tiny@11.17.2/dist/mermaid.tiny.min.js
Vendored file SHA-256: 9a04338a4eb73a5bd449461f12becad20311fa75a6ca41f89fce8f055e7c2bfd
npm package integrity: sha512-PmFr1c5cSfNf5AngLLR98DrbvR4U5KeD7I+hQkGqG5w5Veu3QT4dG0qu9f99cpn/sKj2XxRBK0q7EL6hr9NY/A==
Package metadata declares MIT and no runtime dependencies. The upstream Tiny README states KaTeX rendering is removed; the vendored file contains no KaTeX 0.16.47 version string or renderToString/katex.min.css markers. Generic schema/config text containing "katex" remains, so this notice does not claim a proof that every math-related token was erased. No KaTeX trust option is enabled.
The historical full-Mermaid third-party inventory below is retained conservatively for notice coverage; it is not a claim that every listed package remains runtime-reachable in the Tiny subset. Re-audit reachability when changing the vendored Mermaid/Tiny version.
